evidence: The platform has preset interactive lessons but no teacher workflow that generates editable interactive courseware from an approved lesson-plan revision.
Existing manifest rendering, module registry, response contracts, citation UI, and Provider adapters can be reused after the plan and generated-slide runtime dependencies are available.
The interview requires executable BOPPPS activities, module-level citations and provenance, selected-module regeneration, and paired teacher/student previews.

readiness.reason: Approved-plan binding, progressive generation, activity contracts, evidence, privacy, editing, local regeneration, role views, and durable jobs are specified with two explicit blockers.
